name: smwgraphics-actraiser-font
title: ActRaiser - Font
description:
The font used in ActRaiser.
In the original game, letters have 2 colors, but I also add a version with only one color (because '2 colors' version looks weird with original overworld palettes).

It includes two GFX2A files. I added new characters such as 8, 9, double quotes, which are not in the original gfx (they replace unused tiles), # (not in Act Raiser), and also 'ILLUSI', Yoshi's footprint and 'YELLOW' if needed.

Mod note: for best results, change these colors to make the level names look better.
